You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0168.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

('C',1300,283),#27 ester C
('O',1344,201),#28 ester carbonyl O
('O',1352,366),#29 ester alkoxy O
('C',1444,366),#30 methyl ester
]
edges=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(1,3,1),(3,4,1),(3,5,2),(5,6,1),(6,7,2),(7,8,1),(8,9,1),(8,10,1),(10,11,1),(11,12,2),(11,13,1),(13,14,1),(14,15,1),(15,16,1),(16,17,1),(17,13,1),(16,8,1),(17,18,1),(18,19,1),(19,20,2),(19,21,1),(13,22,1),(22,23,1),(23,24,2),(24,25,1),(25,26,1),(26,17,1),(24,27,1),(27,28,2),(27,29,1),(29,30,1)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for sym,_,_ in atoms: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(sym))
for i,j,n in edges:rw.AddBond(i,j,{1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE}[n])
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms));conf.Set3D(False)
for i,(_,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x/105.,-y/105.,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
for i,j,dr in [(8,9,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(13,14,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(17,18,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)]:
 m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j).SetBondDir(dr)
mb=Chem.MolToMolBlock(m)
open('input.mol','w').write(mb)
m=Chem.MolFromMolBlock(mb, removeHs=False)
print('SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') or a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:print(a.GetIdx(), a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
for b in m.GetBonds():
 if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE:print('alkene',b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx(),b.GetStereo(),list(b.GetStereoAtoms()))
print('molblock',mb[:1300])
PY

cat >> build.py <<'PY'
for ia,ib,sa,sb,st in [(3,5,4,6,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOZ),(6,7,5,8,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE),(23,24,22,25,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOZ)]:
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(ia,ib)
 b.SetStereoAtoms(sa,sb)
 b.SetStereo(st)
print('stereosmile', Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
import copy
for chir in ['CW','CCW']:
 mol=Chem.Mol(m)
 mol.GetAtomWithIdx(16).SetChiralTag({'CW':Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW,'CCW':Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW}[chir])
 Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True,force=True)
 print('test',chir,Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
 mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
 p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=4567;p.numThreads=8;p.pruneRmsThresh=0.35;p.maxIterations=300
 cid=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol,numConfs=30,params=p)
 print('embedded', len(cid))
 if not cid:continue
 res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol,numThreads=8,maxIters=650,mmffVariant='MMFF94s')
 energies=sorted((en,co,int(id)) for id,(co,en) in zip(cid,res))
 print('energy list',energies[:10])
 for energy,code, id in energies[:4]:
  Chem.MolToXYZFile(mol,f'{chir}_{id}.xyz',confId=id)
  print('saved',chir,id,round(energy,2),code)
PY

c=m.GetConformer()
for v in [(4,3,5,6),(1,3,5,6),(5,6,7,8),(22,23,24,25),(22,23,24,27)]:print(v,GetDihedralDeg(c,*v))
